notes.title: Epic Roller Coasters Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Here are the latest bug fixes published on Epic Roller Coasters:


 Fixed bugs in sky scenes.
 Adjusted sound on the Neon Rider roller coaster.
 Improved microphone permissions.
 Improved textures for weapons displayed in the Lobby interface.
 Fixed crashes in the in-game store.
 Wings of Darkness roller coaster cart movement in shooter mode.

notes.title: Major Update: Shooter Bullseye
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We are proud to announce the latest major update for EPIC ROLLER COASTERS, the launch of the new Shooter Mode.

You will find much more than shooting and speed on our roller coasters. Your shooting skills will be reforged, your strategic thinking will be challenged to achieve objectives, your reflexes will be sharpened to respond to the speed of encounters, and your vision will be trained to hunt the most diverse targets.

Get ready to become a fearless gunslinger.

Welcome to your new game mode, SHOOTER BULLSEYE!

notes.title: Roller Coaster update: Dread Blood!
notes.notes:

notes.title: Huge Update!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We are excited to announce that we have many improvements and news for you! Among these we can start by mentioning the visual updates in the Game Menu, where we aim to improve screen navigation and player comfort.

Also, now we got remastered weapons and carts, seeking great improvements in terms of intuition, usability and beauty.

By the way, the Cyberpunk mode is activated since we have many improvements in the Neon Rider! We changed most of the tour, but preserved the atmosphere presente on this roller coaster. Here are some improvements:
• The entire level has been redone, creating the experience of riding a roller coaster in the middle of a metropolis in the future;
• A whole new route that crosses the city, showing from the underground to the top of the skyscrapers;
• A lot of NPCs walking on the streets to create the feeling of a lively and dynamic environment;
• New police cars and drones patrolling the streets and chasing the player;
• New thematic sounds creating an atmosphere of a big city.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32145985/58f2ab42ecdf2a3d6554ca30b2a5ce53159eb885.png

And before we forget, do any of you know what's happening on Lost Forest? We heard rumors that an epic conflict is taking place between native species and creatures from another dimension. Are you ready to watch this great battle up close?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32145985/34f35cbf483b4cadd2eeae3a523834410bf5e6ac.png

We wish you all good luck and hope you enjoy the improvements.

Don’t forget to also check our social media for more updates!

Kind Regards,
B4T Games.

notes.title: Big Update!
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32145985/0ca822b91e2e47324efd35f0a60d52376372fa14.jpg

Hello Steam users!

We are happy to announce that a big update for Epic Roller Coasters is available right now!

In this update, we bring many improvements and also a new DLC, The Wyvern Siege, a roller coaster that takes place during a medieval battle! Armor soldiers, villages, a castle and even a dragon!

Every day we get a lot of comments about the scenarios, we use these comments to improve them and to create new ones, which is the case of Wyvern Siege created from scratch with the whole experience full of adrenalina and the Snow Land that received new events, graphic and sound updates. We are sure that they will amaze you.

We want you to have an incredible experience on all the roller coasters. So we added a lot of Post FX to make the game even more beautiful. And we fixed several small bugs that prevented some players from having fun in the game.

What about to take a ride on the Armageddon roller coaster with Wyvern Siege car? Now you have the hability to exchange any cars between any tracks! We also offered a simple, lower and unprotected car (like an skate) for you to ride on every coaster with it!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32145985/6782ae0e49cbb26c22da26eb2037cbe08d220e8d.png

We also have two more languages available for you to choose in your Game's Properties on the Steam library: Spanish and Portuguese-Brazil.

And now it's possible to play Epic Roller Coasters without a Virtual Reality Headset using only the monitor! But remember that this is a game designed for virtual reality, you will only get to enjoy the whole experience with a headset like HTC Vive or Oculus Rift.

Thank you all for the support and please keep the feedback coming!

 B4T Team
